title: A summer of Do More
summary: 4,000+ Flutter colleagues, 20+ locations, one big idea
body_markdown:
Across Flutter, summer has become a season of action, whereby colleagues look to make a real difference in their local communities through the our[Do More](https://flutter.com/sustainability/community/) strategy. Colleagues and brands are supporting charities in ways that reflect local needs and Flutter's strengths in sport, health and wellbeing. The result is practical, people-powered support for communities where we live, work and play.


Riding and running for Cure Leukaemia


That impact shows up on the road. As[Cure Leukaemia'](https://www.cureleukaemia.co.uk/) s first global corporate partner, Flutter continues to support[The Tour 21](https://www.cureleukaemia.co.uk/get-involved/events/the-tour-21/) and[London2Paris](https://www.cureleukaemia.co.uk/get-involved/events/london-2-paris-2027/) , with colleagues taking on demanding endurance challenges to help fund clinical trials that accelerate access to innovative new treatments for people with blood cancer. In Q2, eight Flutter colleagues took part across Run for a Cure marathons, London2Paris and The Tour 21, raising $30,558 so far, with Tour 21 rider Ryan O'Sullivan still fundraising. The Tour 21 sees amateur cyclists ride the Tour de France route one week ahead of the professionals, while London2Paris brings colleagues together to cycle 500km as part of a 200-strong peloton.


For **Simon Bishop, Director of Polaris Process & Reporting at Flutter,** the cause is personal: "I'm really proud that Flutter supports causes like Cure Leukaemia and gives colleagues the opportunity to get involved in fundraising challenges that make a real difference. In April, I ran the Paris Marathon, my second challenge for the charity, having previously ridden London2Paris. I've personally seen the impact of this disease, from losing one of my best friends at primary school to seeing a running club friend survive leukaemia more recently. That difference is down to the research and progress Cure Leukaemia helps make possible, supported by fundraising and partnerships like this."
